cards.observed_relation: Complete multi-time process reconstruction depends on an informationally complete probe family; restricted deterministic probe classes can leave part of the process space inaccessible even when many measurements are collected.
cards.transferable_relation: Measurement count alone does not establish reconstructive sufficiency; the admitted probe family must span the distinctions the inverse problem asks the decoder to recover.
admissible_assays: Compare candidate ambiguity under matched observation counts while changing only whether the probe family separates the latent candidate space.
alternative_explanations: A probe family may appear sufficient only because the authored latent family is too small or because the decoder receives leaked state labels.
falsifiers: The purported informationally sufficient probe family leaves latent candidates observationally equivalent, or a restricted control performs identically on held-out candidates.
forbidden_inferences: Informational completeness in a finite TD613 fixture is not quantum process tomography and does not imply Hilbert-space completeness.

source.title: Quasiprobabilistic nature of the spatiotemporal Born rule

cards.observed_relation: Sequential quantum measurements require an update structure distinct from a spatially aggregated joint-probability description, and the paper constructs a temporal object for such sequential statistics.
cards.transferable_relation: When observations are generated sequentially, flattening them into an unordered aggregate can discard process information carried by the order of updates.
admissible_assays: Construct same-state-set routes with different order and compare an order-aware process witness against a temporally flattened control.
alternative_explanations: Apparent order sensitivity may come from explicit timestamp leakage, irreversible content mutation, or endpoint drift rather than temporal process structure.
falsifiers: Order-aware and order-blind observers perform equivalently after timestamps, route labels, and endpoint differences are removed.
forbidden_inferences: Classical synthetic order sensitivity is not a quasiprobabilistic quantum temporal state.

source.title: Fluid dynamics reduction methods for temporal networks

cards.observed_relation: The study treats temporal networks as time-ordered sequences of graph snapshots that trace trajectories in graph space and analyzes latent dynamics from that ordered evolution.
cards.transferable_relation: A sequence of states can constitute a trajectory-level object with information that is destroyed when snapshots are reduced to an unordered collection.
admissible_assays: Hold the visited state multiset fixed while permuting temporal order, then test whether a trajectory-sensitive observer can reconstruct the ordering without absolute timestamps.
alternative_explanations: A trajectory model may merely encode absolute position labels or exploit state-frequency differences rather than transition structure.
falsifiers: The route order remains recoverable after the trajectory-sensitive channel is replaced by a state-multiset aggregate, or order recovery depends on timestamp labels.
forbidden_inferences: A TD613 route sequence is not thereby a fluid flow or a physical graph-space trajectory.

source.title: Trajectory Constraints for Imaging Inverse Problems

cards.observed_relation: The proposed inverse-imaging framework explicitly couples consecutive reconstruction states and reports that trajectory-level constraints affect reconstruction quality and stability.
cards.transferable_relation: Intermediate transitions can be part of the inverse-problem object rather than disposable computation, so reconstruction should test path structure separately from terminal fit.
admissible_assays: Compare endpoint-matched reconstructions under intact adjacent-transition structure and a transition-destroying control.
alternative_explanations: A trajectory benefit may arise from generic regularization strength rather than meaningful ordered transitions.
falsifiers: Transition-destroying controls preserve the same held-out reconstruction performance after regularization budget is matched.
forbidden_inferences: A synthetic route trajectory is not a diffusion model or proximal optimization path.

source.title: Scalable tomography of many-body quantum environments with low temporal entanglement

cards.observed_relation: The paper reconstructs long-time influence matrices with limited measurements under an explicit low/moderate temporal-entanglement assumption that constrains process complexity.
cards.transferable_relation: Scalable temporal reconstruction requires an explicit complexity assumption or bound; limited measurements cannot be treated as generically sufficient for arbitrary temporal dependence.
admissible_assays: Vary authored temporal complexity while holding observation budget fixed and measure where reconstruction ambiguity or error sharply increases.
alternative_explanations: Observed scaling limits may come from a particular decoder or finite candidate family rather than temporal complexity itself.
falsifiers: Reconstruction remains equally accurate across increasing temporal complexity without a corresponding increase in admitted measurement information.
forbidden_inferences: A TD613 temporal-complexity bound is not quantum temporal entanglement.
